notes:
Video Studio accelerates realistic cinematic shots that start from a reference photo or continue from the last frame. A verified 332 MB motion adapter uses four steps at the original resolution and 16 generated frames per second. Text-only opening shots retain the full 16-step renderer. Existing installations without the adapter retain the standard path, and the optional Setup-CinematicVideo.ps1 provisions it once per workspace. Interrupted movies with standard checkpoints retain their original rendering style.

Verified the real reference-guided eight-second creek opening on an RTX 3060 12 GB at 1280 × 704 in 213.5 seconds. The new render keeps one fox and a painted turtle. Automated tests exercise references, continuations, 16-step text openings, 184-second assembly and pre-upgrade checkpoint recovery.
